column8: Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendOpenRecursion.Term → Prop := fun response => (∃ result, response = (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.returnedData result).term) ∨ (∃ id, response = (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.queuedData id).term) ∨ ∃ slot, response = (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.ackedData slot).term

∀ {limits : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Limits} {budget : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Budget} {start : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State} {responses : List Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendOpenRecursion.Term} {t : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State}, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCallReference.FrameRun limits budget start responses t → ∀ {L : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Limits} {T : ℕ} {e : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandForcing.Ending} {y : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State}, Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandForcing.endsWith L T budget t = Option.some (e, y) → Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendInteraction.observe budget start responses = Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendInteraction.Node.ofEnding e

∀ {limits : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Limits} {budget : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Budget} {start : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State} {responses : List Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendOpenRecursion.Term} {t : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State}, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCallReference.FrameRun limits budget start responses t → ∃ s, Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandForcing.Chain s t ∧ ∀ (rest : List Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendOpenRecursion.Term), Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendInteraction.observe budget start (responses ++ rest) = Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendInteraction.observe budget s rest

∀ {limits : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Limits} {budget : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Budget} {start : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State} {responses : List Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendOpenRecursion.Term} {t : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State} {ticks address : ℕ} {yielded : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State} {left : ℕ} {extracted : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Result} {response : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendOpenRecursion.Term} {next : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State}, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCallReference.FrameRun limits budget start responses t → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.runCounted limits ticks t = (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Outcome.yielded address yielded, left) → Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.yieldedPlan limits budget yielded = Except.ok extracted → Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.resume response yielded = Option.some next → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCallReference.FrameRun limits budget start (responses ++ [response]) next

∀ {limits : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Limits} {budget : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Budget} {start : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State} {responses : List Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendOpenRecursion.Term} {t : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State}, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCallReference.FrameRun limits budget start responses t → ∀ {ticks address left : ℕ} {yielded : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State} {extracted : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Result}, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.runCounted limits ticks t = (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.Outcome.yielded address yielded, left) → Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.yieldedPlan limits budget yielded = Except.ok extracted → Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendInteraction.observe budget start responses = Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendInteraction.Node.vis extracted.value

∀ {rootBytes : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.Bytes → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {config : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivity.Config} {snapshot : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivity.Snapshot rootBytes} {height : ℕ} {authority : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.Authority} {turn : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId} {fuel : ℕ} {stack : List Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.Ctx} {call : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.CallPlan} {journal : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.Journal} {ticks : ℕ} {result : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data} {journal' : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.Journal} {left : ℕ}, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.exec config snapshot height authority turn (fuel + 1) stack (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.Task.enter call) journal ticks = Except.ok (result, journal', left) → ∃ pin view program meter meter', Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.loadMethod config call.target.value (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivity.packageBytes config snapshot pin) pin call.method (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivity.viewData view) call.args meter = Except.ok (program, meter') ∧ ∃ more out write, (∀ r ∈ more, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCallReference.FrameResponse r) ∧ Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendInteraction.observe config.planBudget (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.initial program.applied.erase) more = Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendInteraction.Node.ret out ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.decodeReturn call.target.value call.method out = Except.ok (result, write)

∀ {rootBytes : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.Bytes → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {config : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivity.Config} {snapshot : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivity.Snapshot rootBytes} {height : ℕ} {authority : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.Authority} {turn : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId} {ctx : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.Ctx} {rest : List Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.Ctx} {start : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State} (fuel : ℕ) {responses : List Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendOpenRecursion.Term} {t : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.State} {journal : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.Journal} {ticks : ℕ} {result : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data} {journal' : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.Journal} {left : ℕ}, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCallReference.FrameRun config.limits config.planBudget start responses t → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.exec config snapshot height authority turn fuel (ctx :: rest) (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.Task.run t) journal ticks = Except.ok (result, journal', left) → ∃ more out write, (∀ r ∈ more, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCallReference.FrameResponse r) ∧ Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendInteraction.observe config.planBudget start (responses ++ more) = Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendInteraction.Node.ret out ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.decodeReturn ctx.object.value ctx.method out = Except.ok (result, write)

∀ {rootBytes : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.Bytes → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {config : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivity.Config} {snapshot : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivity.Snapshot rootBytes} {height : ℕ} {request : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveSend.MessageRequest} (delivery : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveSend.MessageDelivery config snapshot height request) {result : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data} {journal : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.Journal}, delivery.outcome = Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveSend.Outcome.replied result journal → ∃ args pin view program meter meter', Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.decodeDataBytes delivery.message.args = Option.some args ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.loadMethod config request.target (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivity.packageBytes config snapshot pin) pin delivery.message.method (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivity.viewData view) args meter = Except.ok (program, meter') ∧ ∃ more out write, (∀ r ∈ more, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCallReference.FrameResponse r) ∧ Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendInteraction.observe config.planBudget (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.initial program.applied.erase) more = Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendInteraction.Node.ret out ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.decodeReturn request.target delivery.message.method out = Except.ok (result, write)

∀ {rootBytes : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.Bytes → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {config : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivity.Config} {snapshot : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivity.Snapshot rootBytes} {height target : ℕ} {message : Minidregg.Kernel.Inbox.Message} {result : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data} {journal : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.Journal}, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveSend.runMessage config snapshot height target message = Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveSend.Outcome.replied result journal → ∃ args pin view program meter meter', Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.decodeDataBytes message.args = Option.some args ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.loadMethod config target (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivity.packageBytes config snapshot pin) pin message.method (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivity.viewData view) args meter = Except.ok (program, meter') ∧ ∃ more out write, (∀ r ∈ more, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCallReference.FrameResponse r) ∧ Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendInteraction.observe config.planBudget (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandMachine.initial program.applied.erase) more = Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendInteraction.Node.ret out ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveCall.decodeReturn target message.method out = Except.ok (result, write)
